correctness.rationale: Write E(n)=sigma(n)-n-1 (nonunit proper divisors) and cototient C(m)=m-phi(m), so A=E(n)+C(n+2)-1. If n composite and A<5, E<=4; n=p² forces p=2,3 while non-square prime-factor pair p and n/p gives E>=2+3=5. Directly n=4 has A=5, n=9 A=3. Prime n=2 gives A=1. Odd prime n implies m=n+2 odd; for composite m with A<5, C(m)<=5 and C(m)>=m/r>=r for least prime divisor r; r=3 gives m=9 (not 15, C15=7), r=5 gives m=25; hence n=7,23. If m prime, A=0 exactly twin primes. Independent direct exact sigma/totient values for every 2<=n<10000 agreed.
